title: ADC Evidence Event
description: One factual observation of one executed test, published by an ADC testbed/bench to the central Evidence ingest. Technology-neutral: carries no Sphinx-Needs or Requirement-ID concept.

run_id.description: Shared by every event published by one formal run invocation.

event_id.description: Unique within the run; assigned by the publisher if omitted.

producer.description: Stable producer identity, e.g. 'ADC'. Structurally extensible for future project producers (e.g. 'project:<id>') but no such workflow is implemented yet.

test_selector.description: Stable executable selector, e.g. 'tests/test_x.py::test_y' or a whole file/class. The producer does not need to know which Requirement(s) this maps to.

mapped_test_id.description: Never set by the producer. Central ingest resolves test_selector to a TEST_* id and records it in the ingest report, never by mutating a published event.

result.description: Aligned with the existing verification model: IO (in Ordnung/pass), NIO (nicht in Ordnung/fail or error), NOT_RUN (skipped or never executed). Unknown outcomes must never be coerced to IO.

command_or_procedure.description: The exact invoked command or procedure that produced this result.

artifact_identity.description: Tested artifact hash/version where meaningful. Null when not applicable (e.g. ordinary in-repo unit tests).

environment.description: Compact provenance: OS/platform, testbed/bench identity, selected configuration/profile. No secrets.

testbed.description: Stable name of the ADC test environment that produced this event, e.g. 'pytest', 'real_system_e2e'.

evidence_payload.description: Compact structured summary. Never a full log dump.

raw_output_reference.description: Reference to raw output stored elsewhere, never embedded here.
